evidence_items.explanation: The experiments support limitations in intrinsic reasoning self-correction. They neither independently measure superficial understanding nor establish a universal inability to fact-check.

This is material counterevidence to reading fact-checking inability as an inability to detect any factual errors. The sampling-based method does not demonstrate infallible verification or settle the broader causal explanation.

Controlled inference experiments identify training-text memorization and word-frequency heuristics as contributors to errors. These findings are compatible with some readings of shallow understanding, but do not establish Marcus's explanation across all the listed behaviors.

unresolved_gaps: No independent operational definition of superficial understanding is supplied.
The cited experiments do not isolate a common cause of all the listed failures.
The scope of constitutional inability to fact-check remains ambiguous.
